tasks.title: Banner Grab
tasks.description: The pre-login banner frequently reveals the device type/OS (routers, switches, old *nix boxes are common offenders).

tasks.title: Default / Common Credentials
tasks.description: Telnet is almost always left on legacy or embedded devices with weak/default credentials -- try the obvious ones before brute-forcing.

tasks.title: Hydra Wordlist Brute-Force
tasks.description: Cleartext protocol, so credential spraying is fast and reliable to script.
